summary: This is a routine quarterly earnings release filed on Form 8-K by Bridgewater Bancshares Inc. The filing reports financial results for Q2 2026, announces a regular quarterly dividend on its Series A Preferred Stock ($36.72 per share, payable Sept 1, 2026), and includes an earnings presentation. There are no M&A, special distribution, restructuring, or strategic review elements. The filing is purely operational and financial in nature, with no special-situation event triggering a change in corporate structure or control. No deal terms apply.
